result.title: Perception Is Enough, at the Right Scale: Scale-Adaptive Token Pruning for Vision-Language-Action Models
result.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://lin0e0.github.io/TauPrune-VLA/
result.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models must process continuous streams of visual observations, and the resulting computational cost limits real-time robotic control. Token pruning reduces this cost, but a fixed semantic scale of perceptual representation can overlook information needed at different stages of manipulation. We show that perceptual semantics can guide effective token selection without relying on internal attention when the selection scale adapts to the scene's evolving semantic structure. Based on this observation, we introduce TauPrune-VLA, a training-free method that controls the scale of the retained perceptual representation through a single perception temperature $τ$. To adapt this scale as manipulation proceeds, TauPrune-VLA updates $τ$ online using trends in perceptual semantics, with robot-state changes and action magnitude regulating the adjustment strength. While these semantics evolve over the course of manipulation, they remain relatively stable between consecutive frames. This continuity allows retention indices computed from the current observation to be applied at the next policy invocation, enabling token selection to run asynchronously with inference and reducing pruning overhead. Evaluated across diverse VLA models and simulation benchmarks, TauPrune-VLA achieves up to a $1.86\times$ inference speedup while maintaining near-baseline task success rates. We further validate its effectiveness on two real-world robotic platforms.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出免训练的 TauPrune-VLA：用单一 perception temperature 控制保留视觉 token 的语义尺度，依据感知语义变化趋势在线调整该尺度，并利用帧间连续性异步复用保留索引，在多种 VLA 模型和真实平台上取得最高 1.86× 加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 按语义尺度筛选视觉证据、跨帧复用剪枝索引的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉信息保留与计算／缓存分配提供线索；但该工作面向机器人控制效率而非推理期 latent 状态生成，具体联系待核查。
